{{Quote|This Yarkora named Saelt-Marae is a sly one.|A Corellian security official|<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
'''Saelt-Marae''', known by many as '''Yak Face''', was a long-lived [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] confidence trickster and [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who lived for several centuries during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Marae kept details surrounding himself secret, so little was known about his early life. He spent two hundred years courting his chosen [[Saelt-Marae's mate|mate]], and she later bore at least one child of Marae's. Eventually he left her to continue in his life of crime, which was common among the Yarkora people.

Marae specialized in wheedling sensitive information out of various wealthy people without their ever realizing it. He was able to learn how a trader protected his goods by simply speaking with him about almost any topic, before eventually stealing from the trader. He also served as an informant to both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], selling his information to the highest bidder. Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Marae joined the entourage of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], outwardly posing as a harmless [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] while really acting as an informant for Jabba. He ingratiated himself with the Hutt's various employees, gaining their trust and learning of any plots against Jabba. For his part, Marae was handsomely paid. When Jabba was [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|killed]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Saelt-Marae stole many of his secret financial records and disappeared.

==Biography==
===Courting the mate===
[[File:Saelt-Marae.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Saelt-Marae was a Yarkora who lived hundreds of years within the galaxy.]]
Saelt-Marae, or Yak Face as some called him,<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was the possible alias of<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> a mysterious<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Con artist/Legends|confidence trickster]].<ref name="Galactic Files" /> In his [[Standard century/Legends|hundreds]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of life<ref name="NewEGAS" /> during the waning [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Galactic Files /> he spent some [[Time/Legends|time]] trying to impress his [[Saelt-Marae's mate|chosen mate]], having extended discussions with them as they travelled through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and sending their talks though the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] communication service in information packets. It took nearly two hundred years for the courtship to be realized, and together they felt they could discern each other's feelings in a psychic way. Saelt-Marae filled up multiple journals over the years, documenting the pair and his observations on the galaxy that he used for bribery and scheming.<ref name="NewEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Empire">''[[The New Essential Chronology]] dates the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].''</ref> Saelt-Marae was an [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] for the Empire and for the [[Yellow Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> though he was more aligned with the Imperials.<ref name="NewEGAS" /> 

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Saelt-Marae (Jabba's Palace)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569558/2013-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-Series-2-532-Saelt-Marae|archivedate=20231204033353}}</ref> the Yarkora joined the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal organization]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Saelt-Marae presented himself as a<ref name="SWTSE" /> harmless<ref name="Galactic Files" /> [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] focused on the location and [[Currency/Legends|sale]] of religious artifacts from<ref name="SWTSE" /> [[Alien/Legends|alien]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Saelt-Marae}}</ref> cultures thought of as primitive. He also was, apparently, familiar with<ref name="SWTSE" /> and an associate of<ref name="CCG" /> the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr monks]],<ref name="SWTSE" /> a religious order<ref name="SWE" /> residing in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's palace]] on<ref name="SWTSE" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWTSE" /> The Yarkora hung out at the palace<ref name="SWCE" /> and integrated himself with the Hutt, before quietly moving into involve himself into Jabba's entourage.<ref name="SWTSE" /> The Hutt's henchmen did not know that Saelt-Marae was an informant, however.<ref name="SWE" /> Saelt-Marae's tactic was talking with anyone he met, then befriending them to learn all of their secrets behind their back.<ref name="SWCE" /> He amassed a sizable amount of information provided by the continual indulgences of the entourage, often giving it to<ref name="SWTSE" /> the possibly unwitting<ref name="SWCE" /> Jabba for a price.<ref name="SWTSE" />

===Yarkora onlooker===
====Chatting and viewing====
{{Quote|Allow me to introduce myself, I am Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight, and friend of Captain Solo. I know that you are powerful, mighty Jabba, and that your anger with Solo must be equally powerful.|Luke Skywalker introduces himself to Jabba the Hutt via hologram|<ref name="RoTJJN" />}}
[[File:BuboBarking-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|350px|Saelt-Marae and J'Quille (right) talked with each other.]]
In 4 [[Galactic standard calendar|ABY]],<ref name="Joining">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Saelt-Marae sat in a cubicle in the throne room<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]''</ref> of Jabba's palace, chatting with the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] hunter [[J'Quille/Legends|J'Quille]]. As they did,<ref name="Insider60">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> the Rebel [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] entered the throne room accompanied by Jabba's [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|majordomo]]. Saelt-Marae and J'Quille watched on as R2-D2 presented a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] petitioning for the release of his friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was kept encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in the throne room. Jabba declined the offer and the droid pair, now his, were taken elsewhere in the palace.<ref name="RoTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> 

Shortly after, Saelt-Marae then attended a performance of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] in the throne room. He sat in the same cubicle while Jabba's [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] danced to the band's music for the Hutt.<ref name="RoTJ" /> After the woman refused Jabba's demand to sit with him,<ref name="RoTJJN">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi'' (junior novelization)]]</ref> she was dropped into the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit below the throne room. While other members of Jabba's court got up and watched Oola get eaten by the [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]], Saelt-Marae stayed sat in the cubible.<ref name="RoTJ" />

====Hiding in the stairway====
{{Quote|Hey Jabba. Look, Jabba. I was just on my way to pay you back but I got a little sidetracked. It's not my fault.''"<br/>"''It's too late for that Solo. You may have been a good smuggler, but now your bantha fodder.|Han Solo and Jabba the Hutt|<ref name="RoTJJN" />}}
As the court watched the rancor feeding,<ref name="RoTJ" /> the sound of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire<ref name="RoTJJN" /> drew their attention to the throne room entrance. Rebel leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], entered with her ally [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] posing as her capture. Organa wanted more than what Jabba was offering for the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], making her brandish a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] that threatened the life of everyone in the throne room. Jabba, impressed by her fearlessness, gave a slightly higher amount C-3PO encouraged her to take. Deactivating the detonator, she agreed on the pricing<ref name="RoTJ" /> and the throne room party started up again<ref name="RoTJJN" /> as Chewbacca was taken away.<ref name="RoTJ" />

[[File:Stairway at Jabbas palace.png|thumb|right|350px|Saelt-Marae was part of a trap for Leia Organa.]]
When [[Local day/Legends|night]] fell,<ref name="RoTJJN" /> Organa, still in her disguise, made her way through the throne room as Jabba's court slept. She unfroze Han Solo from his carbonite, just before Jabba laughed and alerted them to his presence. The curtains to<ref name="RoTJ" /> Jabba's private elevator and the stairway to the palace's guest quarters<ref name="CL" /> were unveiled, revealing Jabba in the elevator and Saelt-Marae with J'Quille in the stairway. Han Solo was then taken to the dungeons like Chewbacca, while Leia was brought directly to Jabba and soon enslaved.<ref name="RoTJ" />

====Fighting on the Sail Barge====
{{Quote|There will be no bargain, young Jedi. I shall enjoy watching you die.|Jabba the Hutt|<ref name="RoTJJN" />}}
The next morning, after another party in the throne room,<ref name="RoTJJN" /> Saelt-Marae sat in the cubicle once more with J'Quille. As the two slept, Luke Skywalker, let in after using his Force powers on security, walked into the throne room. As Skywalker asked for Solo's release, Saelt-Marae, J'Quille, and others surrounded the Jedi. Jabba, refusing Skywalker's petition again, dropped him into the rancor pit. Skywalker was able to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the rancor with the pit's trapdoor, much to Jabba's anger. After ordering his guards to bring the Jedi and the prisoners to him, Lando Calrissian, another of Skywalker's allies disguised as a guard, pushed his way through Saelt-Marae and J'Quille. The alien pair then watched on as the Rebels were sentenced to death at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in Tatooine's [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. Saelt-Marae and J'Quille then exited the throne room with the rest of the court.<ref name="RoTJ" />

[[File:Saelt-Marae Ree-Yees.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Saelt-Marae argued with Ree-Yees on the ''Khetanna''.]]
Saelt-Marae traveled on Jabba's sail barge, the ''Khetanna'', to view the execution. While on transit,<ref name="RoTJ" /> the Gran drunkard Ree-Yees picked a fight with the Yarkora while drunk.<ref name="FF50 (2014)">{{FactFile2014|50|REE 1-4|Ree-Yees}}</ref> Saelt-Marae forced C-3PO to translate and arguement between him and the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] drunkard [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]], though any talks eventually deteriorated into a drunken brawl between them.<ref name="DB" /> Finally arriving at the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that lay in the Great Pit of Carkoon, Saelt-Marae and J'Quille stood together behind Jabba as he offered the Rebels once last chance to beg for their life. The Hutt then ordered his guards to push Skywalker into the sarlacc, but the Jedi was able to retrieve his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and began [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fighting back]].<ref name="RoTJ" />

Organa, who was on the ''Khetanna'', took the opportunity to smash the controls of the sail barge, closing the ''Khetanna''{{'s}} windows and making the interior dark. Saelt-Marae rushed around the barge just before the woman strangled her Hutt enslaver to death. Together, Organa and Skywalker were able to destroy the sail barge and leave the planet.<ref name="RoTJ" /> Saelt-Marae was not killed when the ''Khetanna'' exploded, however, and he stole<ref name="SWCE" /> many of the Hutt's secret financial records<ref name="Galactic Files" /> before going into hiding.<ref name="SWCE" /> His disappearance also coincided with the raiding of Jabba's bank accounts and the accessing of the Hutt's computer records and financial data. His whereabouts after the Carkoon skirmish remained unknown.<ref name="SWTSE" />

===Documented criminal===
[[File:Corellia_SOF.png|thumb|right|250px|Saelt-Marae visited Corellia (pictured)]]
At some point during his life, Saelt-Marae visited<ref name="EGAS" /> the planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The Yarkora attended an art gallery showing, where he asked many questions to the gallery's [[Unidentified art dealer (Corellia)|dealer]]. To the trusting dealer, he thought he was just discussing philosophy, politics, and religion, not knowing he gave up how he protected his art to Saelt-Marae. A week after their talk, his place was broken into, and some of his art was taken. A [[Unidentified Corellian security officer|security officer]] reporting on the incident mentioned the Yarkora, noting him as sly and slick enough with his questions that the dealer couldn't recall he had given up valuable information. The officer then stated that with Saelt-Marae free, anyone was a possible victim. The documentation was included in ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', a [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] centered around various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species using media collected by [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]]. It was published with the help of a [[Ann Margaret Lewis|professional writer]] no earlier than [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="EGAS" />

Following the publication of the guidebook, an updated version was released. By then, several of Saelt-Marae's written and digital documents had been found on a then unnamed [[Unidentified planet (Saelt-Marae)|planet]] in the Outer Rim territories. They were the most useful of the found recordings and revealed many characteristics about his rarely seen species, such as the process of Yarkora birth, and details of his own life.<ref name="NewEGAS" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Saelt-Marae-RotJAVA.png|thumb|right|300px|Saelt-Marae]]
{{Quote|With this Yarkora on the loose, anyone can be a victim.|Unidentified Corellian security official|<ref name="EGAS" />}}
Saelt-Marae was very secretive, a trait not uncommon among his species. Marae was a loner, who kept his origins and motives secret from his companions, and often kept even his name from them; many in Jabba's court suspected that "Saelt-Marae" was nothing more than a pseudonym, while others referred to him simply as "Yak Face" because of his whiskered, broad-snouted visage.<ref name="SWE" /> Marae was highly intelligent, and was capable of learning much about a being through basic conversation.<ref name="EGAS" /> This talent was bolstered by his psychic abilities&mdash;which sentientologists suspected could have been latent [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities&mdash;and the experience he had gained over the centuries. Marae also used his telepathy to further the bond between himself and his wife. By using this ability they could achieve a greater understanding of what the other was saying, and communicate concepts which could not be put into words.<ref name="NewEGAS" /> Another trait he had in common with his species was his ability to make others uneasy around him. He put this to great use when scouting before a potential robbery and when acting as Jabba's snitch, preying on the weaknesses of others and attempting to intimidate them into providing him with information.<ref name="EGAS" /> In his information gathering, the Yarkora employed his large ears for eavesdropping. He also had highly sensitive whiskers about his large snout.<ref name="SWCE" />

Marae had no qualms about taking advantage of the gullibility of other beings, and cared little for laws. He had no loyalty to anyone but himself, and would betray anyone for the right price. While he attempted to hide his emotions, opinions and motivations from those around him,<ref name="SWE" /> he did occasionally lose his temper. On the journey to Carkoon in 4 ABY, Marae engaged the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] Ree-Yees in a vicious fight, showing his violent side.<ref name="DB" /> He was also known to carry a double-barreled [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] on his person at all times. Marae was a sly being; it was a testament to his craftiness that none of the members of Jabba's Palace whom he spied on ever suspected his true motivations.<ref name="SWTSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MaraeBTS.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Saelt-Marae's mask for ''Return of the Jedi'']]
Saelt-Marae was created for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], where he appeared as a background character in Jabba's Palace. Marae only appeared on screen for a moment,<ref name="Insider60" /> and was given the name Yak-Face during ''Return of the Jedi''{{'s}} production.<ref name="DB" /> He was portrayed by [[Sean Crawford]].<ref name="Website">{{WebCite|url=http://www.coolwatersprods.com/id63.html|text=Sean Crawford|archivedate=20120501182850}}</ref> Yak Face was supposed to have a quarrel with another of Jabba's minions, Ree-Yees, and although it was filmed, it was ultimately cut from the film's release. The fight was included in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novel]], albeit with [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]] taking Yak Face's place, though the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Databank (original)|Databank]] made Marae's fight with Ree-Yees official [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]].<ref name="DB" /> The character was not given a proper name until [[1997]], when the ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'' was released by [[West End Games]].<ref name="SWTSE" /> His name was used as an example Yarkora name in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''<ref name="UAS">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> and ''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> He briefly appears aboard the ''Khetanna'' in one panel of the non-canon comic ''[[The Return of Tag & Bink: Special Edition]]''.<ref name="Tag & Bink">''[[The Return of Tag & Bink: Special Edition]]''</ref>

An action figure of Yak Face was released by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] in [[1985]], though it was never distributed in the United States. Because of this, and because of the overall rarity of the figure, the vintage Yak Face is a highly sought-after collector's piece, and mint figures have sold for thousands of dollars.<ref name="Insider60" />

There is a slight discrepancy about Marae's fate on the ''Khetanna'': ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' establishes that he was killed when it exploded, while ''[[Who's Who in Jabba's Palace]]'' contradicts this, claiming that he survived.<ref name="Insider60" /><ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> As ''Who's Who'' is a more recent source, this article assumes that he survived.
